name: ZGTA V

device_acceptance: ZGTA V 2.0 beta 4 / Build 109 adds proximity voice between iPhone and browser players using the existing microphone and speaker controls. Voices get progressively quieter with distance and are silent beyond 35 metres, with smooth changes while moving. The owner confirmed installation/data, speech both ways, distance reduction/range silence/return and microphone mute on iPhone and Mac. Stable installer 0.109-2 delivers that unchanged tested IPA from the public release; its public metadata wrapper was not separately phone-tested. AppSync remains experimental and not device-tested. Bluetooth/interruption routes, Windows/Android/Linux and Apple Silicon execution remain untested.
